Services, organised the way you buy them.

The NIST Cybersecurity Framework splits security into six functions. Find the one you are buying for and you’ll see exactly what Apex delivers under it, with the framework category beside each line.

GV GovernID IdentifyPR ProtectDE DetectRS RespondRC Recover

GV

Govern

Set the strategy, policy and oversight every other function answers to.

  1. GV.POCompliance readiness for NIST, ISO 27001, HIPAA and CMMC
  2. GV.RMRisk advisory: objectives, measures and defensive strategy
  3. GV.OVGovernance, risk and compliance oversight led by a Chief GRC Officer

Service lines: Consulting & Compliance

ID

Identify

Know your assets, your risks and exactly where you stand today.

  1. ID.RASecurity risk assessments across infrastructure, policy and user behaviour
  2. ID.RAVulnerability and threat analysis to find weaknesses and compliance gaps
  3. ID.RAVulnerability management: misconfigurations and exposed credentials
  4. ID.IMSecurity architecture review for network, cloud and endpoints

Service lines: Consulting & Compliance, Managed Detection & Response, DevOps & App Development, Network Infrastructure

PR

Protect

Safeguard endpoints, networks, doors and the people who use them.

  1. PR.PSNext-gen endpoint prevention that blocks known and new attacks
  2. PR.IRFirewall, SD-WAN, SASE and software-defined networking
  3. PR.AAKey card, fob, mobile and keypad door access control
  4. PR.PSSecure DevOps and software development on Azure and AWS
  5. PR.ATSecurity awareness workshops and the Apex Institute

Service lines: Endpoint Detection & Response, DevOps & App Development, Network Infrastructure, Integrated Security Systems, Apex Institute

DE

Detect

Watch everything, around the clock, and find attacks early.

  1. DE.CM24/7 Managed Detection and Response from a cloud-powered virtual SOC
  2. DE.CMContinuous endpoint monitoring, recording and centralising of activity
  3. DE.AEReal-time alerting and triage of critical events
  4. DE.CMEnterprise security cameras with cloud video management
  5. DE.CMSolar-powered mobile surveillance trailers, for rent or purchase

Service lines: Managed Detection & Response, Endpoint Detection & Response, Integrated Security Systems, Mobile Surveillance Trailers

RS

Respond

Contain incidents fast, with clear guidance on what to do next.

  1. RS.MIHost isolation that stops lateral spread on your behalf
  2. RS.MARapid containment with detailed remediation guidance
  3. RS.ANActive threat hunting and root cause determination
  4. RS.MAIncident response planning and tabletop exercises

Service lines: Consulting & Compliance, Managed Detection & Response, Endpoint Detection & Response

RC

Recover

Restore operations and come back with stronger defences.

  1. RC.RPResponse and recovery protocols, tested before you need them
  2. RC.RPCloud and network infrastructure rebuild and managed services

Service lines: Consulting & Compliance, Network Infrastructure
